submission.natural_language_explanation: Fires retrospectively when the current token completes a conventional two-token chunk begun on the immediately preceding token: a phrasal-verb particle (verb + out/up), a fixed phrase (the same + time/week, called + for), or the second subword of a common word (sle+ek, Swe+at, New+er). Both the preceding trigger and the completing token are required; the same peak token without its trigger is weak.
